ruleBoundaryAssessment.evidence: Direct official description-normalization FAQ explicitly names Xiongshu.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.engineMapping: On accepted invocation, X is prior accepted invocations by this owner/method in the actual round. Attempt min(X, currently legally discardable hand/equipment cards); zero or insufficient discard does not prevent reveal and prediction. Accepted count increments once, not again on child resume.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.mappingExtent: The non-prerequisite property is official. Exact min/eligibility/once-only runtime bookkeeping are explicit engine mappings, not a quoted FAQ.

ruleBoundaryAssessment.evidence: Current text does not add '有手牌' to activation condition. No direct FAQ found.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.engineMapping: Root-selected mapping: offer optional invocation even when the phase owner currently has no hand cards; commit actual count and executable discard, then re-evaluate hand at reveal step. If still empty, complete with no prediction/settlement. Discard children may have given target a card, so do not apply a premature hand gate.

ruleBoundaryAssessment.evidence: Current text requires '使用同名牌'; official normalization article treats elemental Slash as Slash name.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.officiallyConfirmed: Partial: text and Slash typography; no exhaustive Xiongshu-specific FAQ.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.engineMapping: Observe all native actual card uses by the phase owner within the exact selected actual Play phase, including uses earlier than arming, and compare the effective normalized name (elemental Slash unified). Existing qualified own-phase Nullification/Dodge uses count even if the internal typed action is Response; mere played responses such as Duel Slash do not count. Legacy virtual uses without an Action retain their real CardUseFrame ID and do not invent an Action ID. Exclude recast, discard, physical material names, other actors, earlier phases and extra phases with a different identity.

ruleBoundaryAssessment.evidence: Direct current skill text: '展示其一张手牌，你秘密猜测'.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.engineMapping: Use source actor opaque target-hand slot selection without hand-content preview, then public reveal exact physical card. Freeze revealed entity and normalized effective revealed-card name. Keep yes/no guess private to skill owner until settlement; trusted resolution diagnostics may contain private data and are not player snapshots.

ruleBoundaryAssessment.evidence: Direct text only says '若你猜错，你获得此牌'; no official zone enumeration found.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.engineMapping: Engine mapping: obtain the exact shown entity only from the original phase owner current hand/equipment, or public discard/processing. Skip a card now in draw pile, another private hand, other locations or outside game. This is an explicit conservative current-zone whitelist, not an official exhaustive zone FAQ. Native moves retain equipment-removal children and original armor owner recovery.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.decisionAuthority: Explicit engine contract; not claimed as an official FAQ.

ruleBoundaryAssessment.evidence: Current text settles at '此阶段结束时'. No direct loss/regrant/target-death FAQ found.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.officiallyConfirmed: Exact selected phase end is direct text; lifetime corner cases not directly ruled here.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.engineMapping: Engine mapping: immutable issued policy binds original source/binding/instance/hash, actual turn and exact Play phase. Losing/suppressing/reacquiring the skill does not cancel or duplicate an armed policy. Dead owner or target at collection or immediately before consuming a frozen ending candidate causes no reward/damage. An inserted extra phase has a distinct serial; the suspended original ending parent retains its immutable phase key and resumes its original policy without rewinding the serial. Accepted invocation increments actual-round count once even when the post-cost reveal has no hand and creates no policy.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.decisionAuthority: Explicit engine contract; not claimed as an official FAQ.

ruleBoundaryAssessment.evidence: Current text says '上次对你造成伤害的其他角色'.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.engineMapping: Use actual positive applied damage from a distinct other actor; exclude self damage, source-less damage and HP loss. The remembered seat persists across turns until replaced by another qualifying damage source. Do not substitute last targeted player or attempted/prevented damage.

ruleBoundaryAssessment.evidence: No direct official FAQ found for update-memory versus after-damage trigger order.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.engineMapping: Engine mapping: a real positive other-source DamageApplied records the new stable owner/skill/state last source before freezing the same damage incoming discard eligibility. Thus the first other hit already owes discard; a later other source replaces memory. Self/source-less damage and HP loss do not replace it. Physical loss/regrant retains stable memory, and damage during absence does not update it.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.decisionAuthority: Explicit engine contract; not claimed as an official FAQ.

ruleBoundaryAssessment.evidence: Direct text: after owner damages remembered actor draw one; after remembered actor damages owner that actor discards one.
ruleBoundaryAssessment.engineMapping: Use real Draw1 and real target-owned discard chooser/actual movement with exact once-only typed returns; one trigger per qualifying damage occurrence, not per lost HP point. Qualify source before binding, freeze accepted receipt for nested children and handle source loss per established trigger completion contract.

liveCapabilityEvidence.finding: DaoshuGuessState proves a frame-owned private guess mechanism is available, but resolves immediate take/give-back; it does not implement a future exact-Play-phase secret prediction.
Round tracking is capability-dependent; a round-escalating Xiongshu family needs its own dependency declaration.
Native PlayEnding and PlayPhaseStarting windows exist; a delayed prediction must bind the exact actual phase rather than whole-turn history.
ProgramBasicCardName unifies elemental Slash kinds to Slash, reusable for real effective use-name matching.
DamageAppliedEvent carries actual source/target/amount and source-less metadata; ordinary HP loss must not create Jianhui damager memory.
